sqlFinal:
WITH primera AS (
  SELECT cliente_id, MIN(dia_local) AS primera_fecha, MIN(mes_local) AS mes_cohorte
  FROM pedidos
  WHERE cuenta_como_venta = true
  GROUP BY cliente_id
),
retencion_cliente AS (
  SELECT
    pr.cliente_id,
    pr.mes_cohorte,
    MAX(CASE WHEN p.dia_local > pr.primera_fecha AND p.dia_local <= pr.primera_fecha + 30 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS volvio_30d,
    MAX(CASE WHEN p.dia_local > pr.primera_fecha AND p.dia_local <= pr.primera_fecha + 60 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS volvio_60d,
    MAX(CASE WHEN p.dia_local > pr.primera_fecha AND p.dia_local <= pr.primera_fecha + 90 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS volvio_90d
  FROM primera pr
  LEFT JOIN pedidos p
    ON p.cliente_id = pr.cliente_id
    AND p.cuenta_como_venta = true
    AND p.dia_local > pr.primera_fecha
  GROUP BY pr.cliente_id, pr.mes_cohorte
)
SELECT
  mes_cohorte AS mes_primera_compra,
  COUNT(*) AS clientes_nuevos,
  COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE volvio_30d = 1) AS volvieron_30d,
  ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE volvio_30d = 1) / COUNT(*), 1) AS pct_volvieron_30d,
  COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE volvio_60d = 1) AS volvieron_60d,
  ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE volvio_60d = 1) / COUNT(*), 1) AS pct_volvieron_60d,
  COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE volvio_90d = 1) AS volvieron_90d,
  ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE volvio_90d = 1) / COUNT(*), 1) AS pct_volvieron_90d
FROM retencion_cliente
GROUP BY mes_cohorte
ORDER BY mes_cohorte
enPalabras: Cohortes por mes de primera compra con tamaño de cohorte y porcentaje que repitió compra a 30, 60 y 90 días, usando todo el historial
